svg.title: drive_path() on Leg 1
svg.desc: A step-through animation of drive_path() on Leg 1 of the delivery run, seen from above on a 4 by 4 grid. The robot starts at (0, 0) facing North; the destination (2, 3) is ringed. Beside it, the drive_path() loop with the running line highlighted and a box naming the pass. Pass 1: next_pos is (1, 0), desired heading 1, East; the robot turns right to face East and drives to (1, 0). Pass 2: (2, 0), East again: no turn, drive. Pass 3: (2, 1), North: the robot turns left to face North and drives. Passes 4 and 5: (2, 2) and (2, 3), North: no turn, drive. drive_path() returns (2, 3) and heading 0.
svg.text: One pass of the loop per intersection:
work out the heading, turn to face it,
drive there. Then the next pass starts

g.text: North to East: now facing E
East to North: now facing N
the new pose: at (2, 3), facing North
